result:
This looks correct and complete. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass.

I fixed the open-redirect vulnerability in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts:store()`. A new `safeRedirectPath()` helper only accepts values that start with a single `/` — it normalizes backslashes to forward slashes first so `/\evil.example` and `\/evil.example` are caught the same as `//evil.example`, and any absolute URL (having no leading `/` at all) is rejected outright. The post-login redirect now uses `safeRedirectPath(redirect) ?? safeRedirectPath(query redirect) ?? '/dashboard'`, so a rejected value falls back to the existing default destination while legitimate in-app paths like `/posts/3/edit` still work. Login/credential logic is untouched. I added `tests/LoginController.test.ts` covering: default redirect, valid in-app path redirect, rejection of absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, and backslash variants, plus a check that a wrong password still fails with the malicious redirect present.
